tasks.label: build: EEG image for QEMU

tasks.label: check: runtime acceptance suite

tasks.label: update: build and verify the RAUC bundle
tasks.detail: Needs 'make pki' once first. Verifies with the device's own keyring settings.

tasks.label: run: boot QEMU (serial console)
tasks.detail: Interactive. Exit with 'poweroff' inside the guest - closing the terminal leaves the container running and port 2222 bound.

tasks.label: clean up: stop a leaked QEMU container
tasks.detail: The container outlives the docker client, so a closed terminal leaves qemu running.
tasks.command: docker ps -q --filter ancestor=ghcr.io/siemens/kas/kas:5.2 | xargs -r docker stop -t 5
